description: Group `auth`: authorises this domain to send authenticated transactional email through OVEYON on its e-mailbox.com sending infrastructure. Publishes three DKIM aliases, the two return-path aliases that carry bounces and align the envelope sender, and merges the e-mailbox.com sending infrastructure into the domain's SPF record. Group `dmarc`: a monitoring-only DMARC policy (p=none) whose aggregate reports go to OVEYON; the OVEYON dashboard requests this group only when DNS lookups made at click time find no DMARC record for the domain or its parent domains, and leaves it out whenever those lookups are inconclusive.
variableDescription: %dcode%: the numeric identifier OVEYON assigns to this domain. It is the suffix of the two return-path labels, so they cannot collide with anything already on the zone.
